name: agent-gw-frontend
description: Alfred PWA frontend — Markdoc content engine + design system, bundled with esbuild.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=Alfred --minify --outfile=dist/engine.js && esbuild src/launcher/main.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/launcher.js && esbuild src/scan/main.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --outfile=dist/scan.js
scripts.test: node test/render-test.mjs && node test/chart-test.mjs && node test/scan-test.mjs && node test/theme-lint.mjs
